verdict.rationale: Brex's own developer docs describe an official MCP server that lets AI assistants work directly with a Brex account: expenses, users, cards, banking transactions, bills and more. A probe confirmed the documented MCP page at developer.brex.com/docs/mcp. The community posts about AI hallucination concern an earlier ChatGPT experiment, not the MCP server, so they were ignored. Missing for 10: detailed setup, auth and transport documentation in the evidence, a full tool list beyond the summary sentence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account: manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions, track bills, and more through natural language.
official MCP server documented at https://developer.brex.com/docs/mcp
